package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/codestructuretype"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// CodeStructureTypeHandler exposes code structure type endpoints.
type CodeStructureTypeHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  codestructuretype.CreateCodeStructureType
	GetUC     codestructuretype.GetCodeStructureType
	UpdateUC  codestructuretype.UpdateCodeStructureType
	DeleteUC  codestructuretype.DeleteCodeStructureType
	ListUC    codestructuretype.ListCodeStructureTypes
}

type createCodeStructureTypeRequest struct {
	Code             string  `json:"code" validate:"required,max=32"`
	Name             string  `json:"name" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description      *string `json:"description" validate:"omitempty,max=4096"`
	ValidatorService *string `json:"validator_service" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
}

type updateCodeStructureTypeRequest struct {
	Code             string  `json:"code" validate:"required,max=32"`
	Name             string  `json:"name" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description      *string `json:"description" validate:"omitempty,max=4096"`
	ValidatorService *string `json:"validator_service" validate:"omitempty,max=255"`
}

func codeStructureTypeResponse(t *domain.CodeStructureType) map[string]any {
	if t == nil {
		return map[string]any{}
	}
	return map[string]any{
		"id":                t.ID,
		"code":              t.Code,
		"name":              t.Name,
		"description":       t.Description,
		"validator_service": t.ValidatorService,
		"created_at":        t.CreatedAt,
	}
}

// Create handles POST /code-structure-type/create.
func (h CodeStructureTypeHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req createCodeStructureTypeRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	created, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), codestructuretype.CreateCodeStructureTypeInput{
		Code:             req.Code,
		Name:             req.Name,
		Description:      req.Description,
		ValidatorService: req.ValidatorService,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"code_structure_type": codeStructureTypeResponse(created)})
}

// Get handles GET /code-structure-type/get/{codeStructureTypeID}.
func (h CodeStructureTypeHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "codeStructureTypeID")
	structureType, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"code_structure_type": codeStructureTypeResponse(structureType)})
}

// Update handles PUT /code-structure-type/update/{codeStructureTypeID}.
func (h CodeStructureTypeHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "codeStructureTypeID")
	var req updateCodeStructureTypeRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	updated, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), codestructuretype.UpdateCodeStructureTypeInput{
		ID:               id,
		Code:             req.Code,
		Name:             req.Name,
		Description:      req.Description,
		ValidatorService: req.ValidatorService,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"code_structure_type": codeStructureTypeResponse(updated)})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /code-structure-type/delete/{codeStructureTypeID}.
func (h CodeStructureTypeHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "codeStructureTypeID")
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), id); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// List handles GET /code-structure-type/list.
func (h CodeStructureTypeHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.CodeStructureTypeAllowedFields)
	filters, err := parsers.ParseCodeStructureTypeFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	types, total, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), filters)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if types == nil {
		types = []domain.CodeStructureType{}
	}
	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(types))
	for _, t := range types {
		item := map[string]any{}
		if f.Has("id") {
			item["id"] = t.ID
		}
		if f.Has("code") {
			item["code"] = t.Code
		}
		if f.Has("name") {
			item["name"] = t.Name
		}
		if f.Has("description") {
			item["description"] = t.Description
		}
		if f.Has("validator_service") {
			item["validator_service"] = t.ValidatorService
		}
		if f.Has("created_at") {
			item["created_at"] = t.CreatedAt
		}
		items = append(items, item)
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"code_structure_types": items,
		"meta":                 buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}
